cases.proves_bugs: BUG-223 (CDEDIT on a pipe between two open ends, levels typed the other way round: the flow arrow follows the levels, the pipe is not left uphill without a plain warning); BUG-686 (the same with a level of exactly 0.00: the arrow follows the levels). BUG-261 is NOT claimed (its steps reach the reversed pipe through the CD direction question, which a case cannot answer; this case reaches the same stored state through CDEDIT, so a reviewer may accept it as the same fault).
cases.title: Edit Pipe on a pipe with two free ends: levels typed the other way round turn the flow arrow (also with a level of exactly 0.00), and a diameter-only save changes nothing else and warns of nothing
cases.plan_item: Edit Pipe single save (triage group K3; daily card D17 neighbour); BUG-223, BUG-686
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 25 Oct 2026 with BUG-223 (steps: draw a pipe between two open ends, CDEDIT it, type the levels the other way round: not uphill without a plain warning), BUG-686 (CD or Edit Pipe flow arrow, a level of exactly 0.00: the arrow follows the levels) and BUG-261 as written in BUG_CARPARK.md.
cases.expected: A new 20 m pipe with free ends and levels 18.000 / 17.900 has its flow arrow pointing from the first end to the second. CDEDIT with the levels typed 17.900 / 18.000 and Save prints "Pipe updated." and turns the arrow round (the pipe now falls from its second end), or says in plain words that the pipe flows uphill; it never ends uphill with no word. The same for a second pipe drawn 0.50 / 0.00 and edited to 0.00 / 0.50. A second CDEDIT of the first pipe with only the diameter changed to 150 prints "Pipe updated.", says nothing about uphill or any warning, leaves both IL texts and the arrow where they were, and the label reads "150 DIA.". The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The levels, the arrow block and the label are rewritten by the live Edit Pipe save into the real drawing.
not_automated: Which way the arrow points is read from the arrow block's rotation (0 = pointing along the drawn direction, about 3.1416 = turned round); that the picture looks right is a Codex look.

BUG-261 and BUG-292 (pipes whose stored direction is opposite to the drawn direction after a CD direction question) are not claimed: the CD question cannot be answered by a case. BUG-687 (design flow Q saved alone) is not driven: the Q field is behind the More button, which the press list does not allow.
A pipe on pits (levels from the pits) is not driven here; only free ends.
